headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 19, 2026**
article:
The Chicago Cubs dominated the Toronto Blue Jays in a 16-2 victory, with Carson Kelly leading the Blue Jays with 2 hits, including a home run, and 6 RBIs. The Detroit Tigers edged out the Chicago White Sox 4-3 in a close game, with Drew Anderson earning the win. The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Cincinnati Reds 5-0.

Injuries and availability are impacting several teams, with Mark Leiter Jr. (Athletics) placed on the 15-day injured list due to right hip impingement. The Arizona Diamondbacks have placed Michael Soroka on the 15-day injured list with a left glute strain and Jordan Lawlar on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain. The Texas Rangers have transferred Michael Helman from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with a right finger fracture.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Arizona Diamondbacks trading SS Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Atlanta Braves traded RHP Hunter Stratton to the Pittsburgh Pirates for C Joey Bart. The Seattle Mariners traded RHP Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash, and the Toronto Blue Jays traded C Tyler Heineman to the Los Angeles Angels for cash.

top_news.title: **Cubs Rout Blue Jays 16-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the Toronto Blue Jays in a lopsided 16-2 victory. Carson Kelly led the Blue Jays with 2 hits, including a home run, and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down White Sox in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged out the Chicago White Sox 4-3 in a close game, with Drew Anderson earning the win. Matt Vierling led the Tigers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Yankees in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Cincinnati Reds 5-0, securing a shutout victory. Ben Rice led the Reds' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall to Rays in 5-2 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals were defeated by the Tampa Bay Rays with a final score of 5-2. Jonathan Aranda led the Rays' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down White Sox 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox in their recent matchup. Impact hitters for the Tigers included Sam Antonacci and Dillon Dingler, while James Outman led the White Sox offense.

top_news.title: **Reds Rout Yankees 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dominated the New York Yankees, securing a 10-2 victory. Impact players for the Reds included Blake Dunn, Sal Stewart, and Andrew Abbott, who contributed to the team's strong performance.

top_news.title: **Athletics Place Mark Leiter Jr. on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Mark Leiter Jr. has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 18, 2026, due to right hip impingement. The Athletics will reassess his status in the coming days.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks have made a trade, sending SS Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for cash.
